title: Velo Berry Nicotine Lozenges
description:
Buy Velo Berry Nicotine Lozenges Online -For Sale

Velo Berry Nicotine Lozenges Nicotine is extracted from tobacco by Electrolysis and then infused into switchable lozenges. There are two types and four flavors of VELO lozenges. Hard lozenges have a crisp texture, are firm, and maintain their shape as they dissolve. Choose your go-to lozenge, then carry on as usual! Around 1.7mg of nicotine are present in each VELO lozenge.

Product Details

The company’s berry lozenges can be used whenever you need a tasty boost or a discreet nicotine hit. The little lozenges are also contained in tins, each holding 20 pieces. The VELO Hard Berry lozenges do not require spitting.

The fruity lozenges, which exclusively contain nicotine, deliver a consistent nicotine impact. The nicotine released from VELO Berry Hard lozenges is gradual and can last up to 30 minutes. The berry flavor also enhances the effects of nicotine.

VELO concentrates on providing portable lozenges in a variety of flavors and nicotine concentrations in order to cater to its wide customer base. Try the Berry lozenges from VELO and benefit from the fantastic online discounts. Also, ordering is simple and fast for home delivery on the website.

How Are Velo Lozenges Used?

Most likely one of the simplest nicotine products to utilize is VELO lozenges. In actuality, the only challenge you might encounter is attempting to open the child-resistant container. Just insert a lozenge in the side of your mouth after you’ve opened the package. There is nothing to remove or throw away after it dissolves. Your particular preferences and how you use them will determine how long you will enjoy them.

Strengths & Flavors of VELO

There are four varieties of VELO lozenges: mint, berry, dark mint, and crema. Crema has a smooth flavor that is similar to butterscotch and vanilla combined. Berry, on the other hand, is creamier and has a flavor that is a combination of various berries and fruit flavors. Both mint flavors are precise as described—minty but not overly peppery.
